question: Who won the 2025 Laureus World Sportsman of the Year?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Armand 'Mondo' Duplantis**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Armand 'Mondo' Duplantis** was honored with the **2025 Laureus World Sportsman of the Year** award following a historic and dominant **2024** season in athletics.
 
• During the **Paris 2024 Olympic Games**, he successfully defended his title to win the **gold medal**, setting a new **Olympic record** and breaking his own **world record** in the final with a height of **6.25 meters**.
 
• In the **2024** calendar year, he broke the **world record** for the pole vault multiple times, eventually reaching a staggering height of **6.26 meters** at the **Silesia Diamond League** in **Poland**.
 
• His achievements in **2024** included securing the **World Indoor Championship** title in **Glasgow** and the **European Championship** in **Rome**, making him the undisputed leader in his discipline.
 
• He represents **Sweden** on the international stage and has become one of the most recognizable faces in global track and field due to his consistent record-breaking performances.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Laureus World Sports Awards:** Established in **1999** by founding patrons **Daimler** and **Richemont**, these awards are often referred to as the **"Oscars of Sport."** The first ceremony was held in **2000** in **Monte Carlo**, with **Nelson Mandela** delivering a famous speech about the power of sport to change the world.
 
• **Other Nominees for 2025:**
 
 
• **Max Verstappen**: The **Dutch** racing driver who secured his fourth consecutive **Formula 1 World Championship** title in **2024** with **Red Bull Racing**.
 
• **Tadej Pogačar**: The **Slovenian** cyclist who achieved a historic **Triple Crown** in **2024**, winning the **Giro d'Italia**, the **Tour de France**, and the **UCI Road World Championships**.
 
• **Carlos Alcaraz**: The **Spanish** tennis sensation who won both the **French Open** and **Wimbledon** in **2024**, becoming the youngest man to win **Grand Slams** on all three surfaces.
 
 
 
• **Armand Duplantis Profile:** Born on **November 10, 1999**, in **Lafayette, Louisiana**, he holds dual **American-Swedish** citizenship. He comes from a sporting family; his father **Greg Duplantis** was a pole vaulter, and his mother **Helena** was a heptathlete and volleyball player.
 
• **The Selection Process:** Candidates are nominated by a panel of the world’s leading **sports media**, and the winners are subsequently selected by a secret ballot of the **Laureus World Sports Academy**, a group of **71** living sporting legends.
 
• **Significance:** Winning this award places Duplantis in the company of legends such as **Roger Federer**, **Usain Bolt**, **Tiger Woods**, and **Lionel Messi**, who have all won the **Sportsman of the Year** title previously.
